scripts.cloudflare:dev: npm run cloudflare:prepare && npx wrangler@latest dev --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml
scripts.cloudflare:check: npm run cloudflare:prepare && npx wrangler@latest deploy --dry-run --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run cloudflare:prepare && npx wrangler@latest deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.toml
